targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(r.response_time_ms) as value FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location)

SELECT
  response_time_ms as value
FROM (
  SELECT
    r.response_time_ms,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.response_time_ms) as row_num,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
    AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND p.location IN ($location)
) ranked
WHERE row_num = FLOOR(total_count * 0.95) + 1
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  response_time_ms as value
FROM (
  SELECT
    r.response_time_ms,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.response_time_ms) as row_num,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
    AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND p.location IN ($location)
) ranked
WHERE row_num = FLOOR(total_count * 0.99) + 1
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) / 60.0 as value FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location)

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec,
  AVG(r.response_time_ms) as p50,
  MAX(r.response_time_ms) as p99
FROM proxy_requests r
JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
  AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN r.response_time_ms < 500 THEN '< 500ms'
    WHEN r.response_time_ms < 1000 THEN '500-1000ms'
    WHEN r.response_time_ms < 2000 THEN '1000-2000ms'
    WHEN r.response_time_ms < 5000 THEN '2000-5000ms'
    ELSE '> 5000ms'
  END as bucket,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM proxy_requests r
JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
  AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

SELECT
  p.name,
  p.location,
  p.version,
  AVG(pr.response_time_ms) as avg_response_time,
  COUNT(*) as request_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as success_rate
FROM proxies p
JOIN proxy_requests pr ON p.device_id = pr.proxy_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp)
  AND pr.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, p.location, p.version
ORDER BY avg_response_time DESC
LIMIT 20
